item.name: 14 User Review Co-working Space
item.description: A user can review a space only after one of their own reservations there ends. The admin makes Space C (open 00:00-23:59). A new reviewer books a reservation that ends a few seconds later, waits, then reviews it. Viewing reviews is public. Note: this folder fails near midnight Bangkok time, because a reservation must start and end on the same day.
